_note: The 14 tools of the Busymate AI app as ChatGPT sees them (busymate-ai-src#3207: a ChatGPT-registered client is offered only these tools, and each returns only the fields in `dataReturned.fields`, the categories disclosed at https://busymate.ai/apps/privacy#data-returned-by-the-chatgpt-and-claude-apps). Generated from the live server by scripts/gen-tools.mjs; scripts/scan-live.mjs compares it with the live tools/list.

tools.name: list_tenants
tools.title: List Workspaces
tools.summary: Lists the workspaces you can see, up to `limit`.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Only reads data in a workspace the signed-in user belongs to; it changes nothing.
justifications.destructiveHint: Reads only, so nothing is changed or removed.
justifications.openWorldHint: Acts only inside the user's own Busymate AI workspace.

tools.name: get_tenant
tools.title: Get Workspace
tools.summary: Returns one workspace by `tenant_id`: slug, name, status, settings, member count, domain mappings (host, primary, verified time) and whether you administer it.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Only reads data in a workspace the signed-in user belongs to; it changes nothing.
justifications.destructiveHint: Reads only, so nothing is changed or removed.
justifications.openWorldHint: Acts only inside the user's own Busymate AI workspace.

tools.name: get_tenant_inbox_counts
tools.title: Get Workspace Inbox Counts
tools.summary: Returns the inbox badge counts for a workspace, excluding automated system mail: totals by type and channel, assignment counts (mine, unassigned, all) and counts per label, team and folder.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Only reads data in a workspace the signed-in user belongs to; it changes nothing.
justifications.destructiveHint: Reads only, so nothing is changed or removed.
justifications.openWorldHint: Acts only inside the user's own Busymate AI workspace.

tools.title: Reply Workspace Intervention
tools.summary: Sends the operator `message` into the active human-intervention request `request_id` of a workspace.
